references.text: The Lord's entry into Jerusalem is prophesied, mirroring the event in Mark 11:4 where Jesus finds and unties the colt.
The verse is part of a psalm sung during festive entries into Jerusalem, which can be seen in connection with Jesus' entry into the city.
Matthew gives a parallel account of the event where Jesus sends the disciples to fetch a donkey and a colt.
Luke's account of the same mission emphasizes Jesus' foreknowledge and authority.
John also mentions Jesus' entry into Jerusalem on a donkey, fulfilling the prophecy and linking the event to Mark 11:4.
